narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as the US-Iran conflict escalates with active kinetic exchanges, an Apache shootdown, and a prolonged Hormuz blockade. Simultaneous Ukraine deep strikes and Israel's two-front war amplify the perception of uncontrollable multi-theater conflict, driving flows into safe havens.
narratives.trade_implication: Long gold, short S&P 500 futures, and add WTI crude oil longs on dips; hedge with long-dated US Treasuries.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Structural Oil Shock
narratives.summary: The EIA's extended blockade timeline through Q3 2026 and Kuwait's pipeline bypass discussions confirm a structural supply disruption. Despite diplomatic noise, capital is rotating into energy equities and commodities as the blockade bites, with WTI forecasts rising to $88+.
narratives.trade_implication: Overweight energy sector ETFs and long WTI futures; underweight consumer discretionary and airlines.

narratives.title: Institutional Crypto Adoption Divergence
narratives.summary: While BTC sells off with macro risk-off, institutional flows into crypto infrastructure continue, evidenced by Janus Henderson's partnership with Ethena for tokenized CLOs. Capital is bifurcating between speculative retail de-risking and long-term institutional positioning in DeFi and AI-related tokens.
narratives.trade_implication: Accumulate ETH and select DeFi tokens (e.g., ENA) on weakness; avoid BTC leveraged longs until macro stabilizes.
